english.title: Landlord causing overcrowding of a dwelling
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the landlord of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), caused it to be overcrowded in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF OVERCROWDING..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 331(1) and (3) of the Housing Act 1985.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

english.notes: Section 331 - Thelandlord shall be deemed to cause or permit it to be overcrowded in thefollowing circumstances, and not otherwise - (a) if he or a personeffecting the letting on his behalf had reasonable cause to believe that thedwelling would become overcrowded in circumstances rendering the occupierguilty of an offence;(b) if he or a person effecting the letting on his behalffailed to make inquiries of the proposed occupier as to the number, age and sexof the persons who would be allowed to sleep in the dwelling;(c) if notice isserved on him or his agent by the local housing authority that the dwelling isovercrowded in such circumstances as to render the occupier guilty of anoffence and he fails to take such steps as are reasonably open to him forsecuring the abatement of the overcrowding, including if necessary legalproceedings for possession of the dwelling.
english.standardstatementoffacts: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, being the landlord of a dwelling at **(..SPECIFY ADDRESS..), caused it to be overcrowded in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF OVERCROWDING..).

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding level two on the standard scale and, for every day subsequent to the date of conviction that the offence continues, to a fine not exceeding one-tenth of level two.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
